description: This file defines the Order model class for the admin module of the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It provides methods for managing orders, including retrieving, deleting, and updating order data, as well as related entities such as products, histories, totals, options, and subscriptions. It acts as a data access layer interacting with the database for order-related operations.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Class Order extends the base Model class in the Opencart system, encapsulating all order-related database interactions such as creating, retrieving, updating, deleting orders, managing associated products, histories, totals, options, and subscriptions.

methods.name: deleteOrder
methods.description: Deletes an order and its related products, totals, and histories from the database based on the given order ID.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Retrieves comprehensive details of a specific order, including related geographical, customer, language data, and products, along with computed reward points.

methods.name: getOrders
methods.description: Fetches a list of orders based on provided filter criteria such as order ID, customer, store, status, date range, and pagination options.

methods.name: getTotalOrders
methods.description: Counts the total number of orders matching specified filter criteria.

methods.name: getOrdersBySubscriptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of orders associated with a specific subscription ID, with optional pagination.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByLanguageId
methods.description: Returns the total count of orders for a specified language ID.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByCurrencyId
methods.description: Returns the total count of orders for a specified currency ID.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersBySubscriptionId
methods.description: Counts orders associated with a specific subscription ID.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByStoreId
methods.description: Counts orders placed in a specific store.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByOrderStatusId
methods.description: Counts orders with a specific order status ID.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByProcessingStatus
methods.description: Counts orders currently in processing statuses configured in the system.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByCompleteStatus
methods.description: Counts orders with a complete status, based on configuration.

methods.name: deleteProducts
methods.description: Removes all products linked to a specific order, including options and subscriptions.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Fetches data for a specific product within an order.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves all products associated with a specific order.

methods.name: getTotalProductsByProductId
methods.description: Counts total quantities ordered for a specific product across all orders with active status.

methods.name: deleteOptions
methods.description: Deletes all options associated with a specific order.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Retrieves options attached to a particular order product.

methods.name: deleteSubscription
methods.description: Removes a subscription record linked to an order.

methods.name: getSubscription
methods.description: Fetches subscription details for an order product.

methods.name: deleteTotals
methods.description: Deletes all total entries associated with an order.

methods.name: getTotals
methods.description: Retrieves all total entries for an order, ordered by sort order.

methods.name: getTotalsByCode
methods.description: Gets total entries for specific codes within an order.

methods.name: getTotalSales
methods.description: Calculates the sum of totals for orders matching optional filtering criteria.

methods.name: createInvoiceNo
methods.description: Generates a new invoice number for the order if it doesn't already have one.

methods.name: getRewardTotal
methods.description: Calculates total reward points earned from products in an order.

methods.name: deleteHistories
methods.description: Removes order history records for a specified order.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Retrieves history records for an order, with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Returns the total number of history records for an order.

methods.name: getTotalHistoriesByOrderStatusId
methods.description: Counts the number of order histories for a specific status ID.

methods.name: getEmailsByProductsOrdered
methods.description: Fetches distinct emails of customers who ordered specific products, with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalEmailsByProductsOrdered
methods.description: Counts the number of distinct customer emails who ordered specified products.
